Exam Compass

The Subject-to-Exam Calculator

Around the world the same handful of exams get all the attention. The sharper question is the reverse: given the subjects you're actually strong in, which global exams are you best positioned to clear? Rate your strengths, and this ranks the major international admissions, licensure and certification exams by how well they fit you — then tells you what each one truly demands, because two exams needing the same subjects can be completely different fights.

Language proficiency exams — a different kind of test

These certify a specific language rather than a transferable subject strength, so they sit outside the fit engine. If the target language is your strength, they're criterion-referenced — reach the required band and you're through.

How Exam Compass works

Every exam is tagged with the subjects it actually tests and how much each one weighs. You rate your strength in each subject from 0 to 10, and the tool computes a fit — how well your strengths cover that exam's syllabus — for all of them at once, then ranks them. Where an exam has a gate subject you can't clear without (Biology for NEET, a core discipline for GATE), a strength below the floor flags the exam as blocked, because coverage elsewhere can't rescue it. Pick-your-subject exams (JAM, the NET papers) are scored on your single strongest relevant subject, so specialists aren't penalised. Alongside fit, each exam carries its psychometric nature — the crucial distinction between an elimination bottleneck that ranks you against millions for a sliver of seats, a competency gate you clear against a fixed bar, a broad aptitude gauge, and a talent search for the exceptional few. Two exams needing identical subjects can be entirely different bets, so "Most winnable" re-sorts fit by how selective each exam truly is. The portfolio read-out shows your highest-leverage subjects, the field your strengths cluster in, and the exams that a single subject's improvement would unlock.

The exam roster, subject weightings, gate subjects and psychometric classifications are illustrative, editable seeds drawn from a public exam-structure dossier — not official syllabi, eligibility rulings, or a guarantee of selection. Real exams change their patterns, weightings and eligibility every cycle, and clearing any of them depends on preparation, competition and circumstance far beyond subject aptitude. This is a discovery and thinking tool to help you aim at the exams that suit your strengths — not admissions, career, or eligibility advice. Always confirm the current pattern with the conducting body before you commit.

No agenda in the output. All agency in the decision.
